_comment: Usage descriptions shown by macOS when the app asks for a permission. scripts/gen_config.py copies the keys of the permissions listed in starter.json into Info.plist (en) and <lang>.lproj/InfoPlist.strings. Say what the app uses the access for; promise more (stays on the Mac, nothing is uploaded) only when the project keeps it and a test proves it. These are the starter's defaults (rules/standard/infoplist.json): after bin/starter init, make check-texts reports every default left for a permission that starter.json lists.

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.en: The app uses the microphone to record what you say.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.de: Die App nutzt das Mikrofon, um aufzunehmen, was du sagst.

NSCameraUsageDescription.en: The app uses the camera to take pictures.
NSCameraUsageDescription.de: Die App nutzt die Kamera, um Bilder aufzunehmen.

NSAppleEventsUsageDescription.en: The app asks other apps for details such as the title of the open document.
NSAppleEventsUsageDescription.de: Die App fragt andere Apps nach Angaben wie dem Titel des geöffneten Dokuments.

NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.en: The app turns what you say into text.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.de: Die App wandelt in Text um, was du sagst.

NSContactsUsageDescription.en: The app reads your contacts to fill in the names you pick.
NSContactsUsageDescription.de: Die App liest deine Kontakte, um die Namen einzusetzen, die du auswählst.

NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription.en: The app reads and creates calendar events when you ask it to.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription.de: Die App liest und erstellt Termine, wenn du sie darum bittest.

NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription.en: The app reads and creates reminders when you ask it to.
NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription.de: Die App liest und erstellt Erinnerungen, wenn du sie darum bittest.

NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.en: The app opens the photos you pick.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription.de: Die App öffnet die Fotos, die du auswählst.

NSLocationUsageDescription.en: The app uses your location to show results near you.
NSLocationUsageDescription.de: Die App nutzt deinen Standort, um Ergebnisse in deiner Nähe zu zeigen.

NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription.en: The app uses your location to show results near you.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription.de: Die App nutzt deinen Standort, um Ergebnisse in deiner Nähe zu zeigen.

NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription.en: The app uses Bluetooth to connect the devices you choose.
NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription.de: Die App nutzt Bluetooth, um die Geräte zu verbinden, die du auswählst.

NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription.en: The app searches your local network for devices.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription.de: Die App sucht in deinem lokalen Netzwerk nach Geräten.
